## Phase: 11 - Process Hardening

### Enforcement Architecture
from: [[decision:layered-gate-enforcement-automated]]
retrieved: 2026-05-19

- Two layers: preventive (pre-flight refusal in implementation-guide.md) + detective (gate-compliance audit in dev-debrief retro-check)
- Preventive = instructional enforcement at agent-compliance boundary, not shell-level blocking
- Detective = parse tasks.md gate log comments, flag SKIPPED without justification
- Pattern mirrors Tier 0 structural + Tier 1 semantic from /spec review gate

### Process Failure Patterns
from: [[decision:gate-enforcement-checklist-plus-log]]
retrieved: 2026-05-19

- Fail-open is the LLM pipeline default — tiered verification (structural then behavioral) is the defense
- All 3 violations clustered during execution momentum (5 phases in one session) — not malice, compliance gaps
- Documentation-only enforcement proved insufficient; structural enforcement required

### Gate Format Reference
from: [[decision:gate-enforcement-checklist-plus-log]]
retrieved: 2026-05-19

- active-phase.md Gates section: checkbox list, [ ] = unchecked, [x] = passed
- tasks.md gate log: HTML comment `<!-- gates: spec=N/10 approach=yes plan-review=N/10 tasks=yes -->`
- Standard ceremony expects: spec, approach, plan-review, tasks (all 4)
- Lite ceremony expects: approach, tasks (2 of 4)
